notes:
{湯葉|ゆば} is a delicate soy product made from the skin that forms when soy milk is heated.

WRITING:
- ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water)
- {葉|ば} (leaf)
- Describes the thin, leaf-like appearance

HOW IT'S MADE:
- Heat soy milk in a shallow pan
- Skin forms on the surface
- Carefully lift off the film
- Can be eaten fresh or dried

TYPES:
- {生|なま}{湯葉|ゆば} (fresh yuba - soft, creamy)
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{湯葉|ゆば} (dried yuba - for cooking)
- {巻|まき}{湯葉|ゆば} (rolled yuba)

REGIONAL ASSOCIATIONS:
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ - Most famous, often served at temples
- ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧ - Another famous production area
- Buddhist vegetarian cuisine (⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧)

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- お⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (sashimi style - fresh)
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dishes)
- ⟦お{吸|す}い{物|もの}→お吸い物：15773_osuimono⟧ (clear soup)

- Low in calories
- Popular among health-conscious eaters
- Vegan-friendly
